description: Actuarial present value engine. Discount expected cash flows with mortality, survival, and risk adjustment for insurance and benefit obligations, generalising IFRS 17 (fulfilment cash flows), IAS 19 (employee benefits), IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and IAS 37 (provisions). Use this for regulated IFRS/HKFRS obligations only; it does NOT do generic project or scenario probability weighting (use calculate_expected_value). Methods: ifrs17_gmm: cash_flows, discount_rate, risk_adjustment; ifrs17_paa: premiums, claims_cash, acquisition_cash_flows, coverage_periods; ifrs17_vfa: cash_flows, discount_rate, underlying_items_return, risk_adjustment; ias19_puc: projected_benefits, discount_rate, attribution_years; ias37_provision: outcomes, probabilities, discount_rate, periods. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

acquisition_cash_flows.description: Acquisition cash flows in reporting currency.

cash_flows.description: Projected cash flows in reporting currency, indexed t=1..n.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%); pre-tax when method=viu_pre_tax.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

probabilities.description: Cumulative success probability per period in [0,1], aligned with cash_flows.

risk_adjustment.description: Explicit risk adjustment for non-financial risk.

name: calculate_actuarial_pv

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Actuarial present value
